entities.summary: Rosa Ginossar (1890–1979) was an Israeli lawyer and women's rights activist. She was the second woman lawyer in Mandatory Palestine, after Freda Slutzkin) and the first practicing female attorney in Israel. She was president of the Women's International Zionist Organization from 1966 to 1970.
